meta.title: Modale werkwoorden van waarschijnlijkheid
meta.subtitle: must, might, could en can't voor nu en voor het verleden, en should have

blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: aangeven hoe zeker je bent met must, might, may, could en can't
hetzelfde doen over het verleden met must have, might have, can't have
spijt en kritiek uitdrukken met should have
zeggen wat mogelijk was met could have

head: Werkwoord
Zekerheid
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: She must be tired. She worked all night.
That can't be Tom. He's in Spain.

blocks.title: must = vast, moet wel
blocks.text: In deze betekenis is must geen verplichting maar een conclusie: Hij moet wel rijk zijn = He must be rich. Het tegendeel is can't, niet mustn't: Dat kan niet waar zijn = That can't be true.
Voor een conclusie over het verleden gebruik je modaal werkwoord + have + voltooid deelwoord.

head: Vorm
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: The ground is wet. It must have rained.
She might have missed the bus.
Ze heeft misschien de bus gemist.
Hij zou vertraging gehad kunnen hebben.
You can't have seen him. He was abroad.
Je kunt hem niet gezien hebben.

blocks.title: have, niet of
blocks.text: In spreektaal klinkt must have als 'must've', en veel mensen schrijven dan per ongeluk must of. Dat is fout. Schrijf altijd must have, should have, could have.

head: Vorm
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: Dat had je niet moeten zeggen.
Je had geen bloemen hoeven te kopen.

blocks.title: had moeten = should have
blocks.text: Ik had het moeten weten = I should have known. Het Nederlands zet had vooraan, het Engels zet have na should. Nooit I had must know.

rows: He mustn't be at home. The lights are off.
He can't be at home. The lights are off.
It must have rained last night.

blocks.text: Vul het juiste modale werkwoord of de juiste vorm in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: You've been travelling all day. You ______ be exhausted.
items.full: You've been travelling all day. You must be exhausted.

items.q: That ______ be Anna. She's in Australia.
items.full: That can't be Anna. She's in Australia.

items.q: Take an umbrella. It ______ rain later.
items.full: Take an umbrella. It might rain later.

items.q: The window is broken. Somebody must ______ thrown a stone.
items.full: The window is broken. Somebody must have thrown a stone.

items.q: I ______ have studied more. I failed the test.
items.full: I should have studied more. I failed the test.

items.q: She can't have ______ the letter. It's still here.
items.full: She can't have sent the letter. It's still here.

items.q: We ______ have won if we had played better.
items.full: We could have won if we had played better.

items.q: You ______ have told me! I didn't know.
items.full: You should have told me! I didn't know.

items.q: He isn't answering. He ______ be asleep.
items.full: He isn't answering. He may be asleep.

items.q: They're late. They might have ______ the train.
items.full: They're late. They might have missed the train.
